'''Karrek Flim''' was a [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Karrek Flim operated on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], primarily from [[Vreni Island]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was both romantically and professionally linked with [[Didina Lippinoss]], whom he employed to commit various criminal activities.<ref name="AED" />

At some point between [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Flim was implicated in the leveling of several old-growth forests in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Didina Lippinoss hired a wandering [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover the records implicating Flim. Around the same time, [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] took an interest in Flim, and hired [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]] to gather incriminating evidence against him by having Lippinoss followed by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] informant [[Sli'woon Biul]]. Bombaasa planned to release details of Lippinoss's criminal activities committed on Flim's behalf if Flim did not comply with Shalera's demands. Bombaasa further attempted to blackmail Lippinoss into funneling classified CSA data from Flim's hands to Bombaasa's, but she did not cooperate.<ref name="AED" />

Around the same time, one of his underling's tried to damage Flim's reputation by hiring a [[Slicer/Legends|data slicer]] to alter shipping documents to make Flim seem incompetent and corrupt. When [[Vinya Maysor]], who worked for Flim, learned of this attempt, she hired a slicer herself to alter records that would make the underling look like a fool instead.<ref name="AED" />
